defect: Two records on main disagreed about whether FO-01 still blocked ADR acceptance. fo-01-repair-status.json asserted REPAIR_COMPLETE_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION with independent_verification.performed=false; FO01_RESOLUTION_RECEIPT.json, written later after the audit, asserted TRACEABILITY_REPAIRED_AND_INDEPENDENTLY_REVERIFIED. The stale copy lives in the authority tree, so it surfaced first and read as 'never verified'. The finding is the disagreement, not an absence of verification.
resolution: The receipt is later in time and supersedes. The status record now mirrors it.
semantic_collision_avoided: gates.adr_acceptance=CLOSED means the acceptance gate is shut; fo01_gate_condition=CLOSED means the FO-01 blocker is closed. Opposite senses of the same word. Rather than overload either field, gate eligibility was recorded in separately named keys and the distinction written into gate_field_semantics in the file itself.

validation_expanded_round_2.finding: MUST_FIX 5 — the reconciliation check was partial.
validation_expanded_round_2.detail: Several receipt-derived fields (nonblocking_observations, the auditor identity block, the source hashes) could drift while the checked subset still passed.
validation_expanded_round_2.resolution: Group B now computes the full expected projection from the receipt and compares all 39 mapped fields, pins the 37 fields that are not receipt-derived, requires the traceability matrix to be present rather than skipping when it is absent, and fails on any status leaf that is not classified as projected, pinned, matrix-derived or declared prose.
validation_expanded_round_2.note: fo-01-repair-status.json itself is unchanged in round 2. The finding was about the strength of the check, not the content of the record.
